name: Aqua Dome
kurzbeschreibung: Aqua Dome – Tirol Therme Längenfeld in the Ötztal Valley is an architecturally futuristic alpine thermal spa featuring levitating outdoor pool basins and world-class saunas.
preis: Admission charges apply (various ticketing tiers for thermal pools, sauna world, and day passes)
beschreibung:
Überblick

The Aqua Dome – Tirol Therme Längenfeld, nestled at the center of the dramatic Ötztal Valley, ranks among the most architecturally groundbreaking thermal spa resorts in the European Alps. Framed by the jagged three-thousand-metre peaks of the Stubai and Ötztal ranges, this expansive wellness sanctuary harmonizes therapeutic mineral waters with avant-garde alpine design. Its defining architectural hallmark consists of three futuristic outdoor pool basins that appear to hover weightlessly above the landscape, anchored upon massive pylons and interconnected through a crystalline glass cone. The thermal pools are fed by warm, sulfur-rich geothermal springs bubbling up from 1,865 metres deep underground. Beyond the open-air mineral basins and bubbling effervescent loungers, guests discover the vast 'Gletscherglühen' sauna village, stone-pine relaxation zones, and the dedicated 'Alpen Arche Noah' children's aquatic world with waterslides, making it equally rewarding for serene relaxation and family holidays.

Route & Anforderungen

A visit to the Aqua Dome provides restorative pleasure year-round regardless of mountain weather, proving particularly sublime during brisk winter afternoons or rainy days. The entire resort complex is universally barrier-free and fully accessible from the underground parking garage to pool entries, featuring assistive aquatic lifts for guests with reduced mobility. To truly decompress, plan for a stay of three to four hours or indulge in a full day ticket. Guests need only bring standard swimwear, pool towels, and non-slip sandals; premium plush bathrobes and oversized sauna towels can be rented conveniently at the reception counter.

Besuch & Anreise

Motorists travel via the Inntal Motorway A12 (exit Ötztal) and follow the federal highway B186 (Ötztalstraße) south through the valley past Sautens and Umhausen directly into Längenfeld. Thermal guests enjoy extensive covered underground parking equipped with electric vehicle charging stations as well as open-air lots. By public transport, take Austrian Federal Railways (ÖBB) to Bahnhof Ötztal and transfer directly to regional bus line 4194 departing every thirty minutes, alighting at the Längenfeld Therme bus stop right at the resort entrance.

Tipps

Experience evening night bathing inside the illuminated outdoor basin bowls: as alpine dusk settles over the Ötztal summits, geothermal steam rises mystically against star-studded mountain skies. Especially during peak winter ski season and on weekends, reserve your time-slot tickets online in advance to bypass ticket queues at the front desk.
